title: Idempotent integration: never merge a node twice after a crash
observation: State-machine hunting with a crash kill-point between the integration merge and saving the run record found nodes merged twice with different content (4 violations in 40 seeds).
suggested_direction: Use the unique integration commit subject (run + node) as an idempotency key: look it up on the integration branch before merging and adopt the existing commit.
acceptance: No duplicate integrate commits across >= 80 hunted seeds with crash kill-points
Regression test for the crash window
